_metadata.description: English translations for Resources 41 (Church of Salem), 42 (Adventurer's Inn), and 45 (Vigger Shop) matched against guide_full.txt
_metadata.note: Guide provides contextual/story translations but not direct NPC menu dialogue. Translations are produced by matching Japanese UI text to guide terminology and Wizardry conventions.
